raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- Kimi-K3 TP8 on gfx950 runs 12 MLA heads per rank (zero-padded to 16) with an FP8 KV cache.
- Decode and short verify windows default to AITER Gluon. On AgentX c1 traffic (long context, DSpark block 7 / 8-token verify) Gluon is the per-step latency bottleneck: P90 ITL 6.77 ms vs 6.18 ms on the persistent FP8-query ASM kernel (5.18 vs 4.50 ms with the AMD MonoKernel on).
- The ASM route cannot be turned on for this backend alone today: `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_PERSIST` is process-wide and would also move draft extend and other backends.
- AITER's FP8-query kernels return wrong output for 2-4 token windows (ROCm/aiter#7007), so the route must skip those windows.

## Modifications

- New opt-in route: on an eligible backend, decode and the target-verify window run on the persistent FP8-query ASM MLA kernel.
  - Eligible: gfx950, 12 heads with zero padding, FP8 KV, `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DECODE_BACKEND=asm` and `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_VERIFY_BACKEND=asm`, no DCP.
  - Persistence is scoped to that backend instance (`_mla_ps_kernel_enabled()`); under `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_PERSIST=0`, draft extend and other backends keep the non-persistent path and a bf16 query.
  - Metadata uses the `PERSIST=1` schedule; KV splits follow `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_AUTO_KV_SPLITS`.
  - The query is quantized with the saturating static FP8 quant (scale 1.0), so out-of-range values clamp instead of becoming NaN. This also applies to the existing >4-token FP8-query cast.

| New env var | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM` | `false` | Run decode and short verify on the FP8-query ASM kernel for an eligible backend |
| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_MAX_QLEN` | `4` | Widest verify window (1-8) the route takes; 5-8 fold onto AITER's 32-head qlen-4 kernel, which beats Gluon only from about 128K context on MI355X. Out of range raises at startup when the route is on |

| Verify window (`num_draft_tokens`) | Route with the opt-in on |
|---|---|
| 1 (no spec, decode only) | FP8-query ASM |
| 2-4 | previous routing (ROCm/aiter#7007) |
| 5 to `MAX_QLEN` (needs `MAX_QLEN` >= 5) | FP8-query ASM, folded |
| above `MAX_QLEN` | previous routing |

- Tests (`test_aiter_gluon_h12_fp8.py`, CPU): selector conditions, window bounds, per-instance persistence scope under `PERSIST=0`, module modes under `PERSIST=1` with auto KV splits, query cast, saturation, and the bf16 query on non-persistent calls.

## Accuracy Tests

| Route | Deterministic? | Max absolute error vs FP32 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Gluon | yes | <= 8e-3 |
| FP8-Q ASM decode | yes | <= 8.8e-3 |
| Folded FP8-Q ASM, window 5-8 | yes | <= 1.6e-2 |

- Kimi-K3 c1 GSM8K with real acceptance on the current recipe: 0.970.

Model eval, on/off: `sgl-eval 0.1.3 run gsm8k --load-preset-from-model-id moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --num-threads 32` (full 1319, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, thinking on, reasoning_effort max).

| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM` | GSM8K | Truncated | Errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 (this PR's route) | 97.27% | 0 | 0 |
| 0 | 97.42% | 0 | 0 |

- The gap is 2 questions, within sampling noise (single-run stderr ~0.45 pp at temperature 1.0).
- Setup: 8x MI355X, `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, AgentX c1 recipe (TP8, DCP1, DSpark block 7, `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_MAX_QLEN=8`, asm decode and verify). Only the switch differs.
- Simulated acceptance off (real outputs); AMD monokernel off (`K3_AGENTX_AMD_MONOKERNEL=0`) so the attention route under test runs.
- Build: `k3-agentx-pr-stack` @ `39d944c57d` with this PR's head `bad593f2c7` merged in; ROCm/aiter stack @ `f9b5308b2`.
- `test_aiter_gluon_h12_fp8.py`: 39 passed on this head.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Kimi-K3 AgentX A/B on 8x MI355X, SGLang `91a841a004`. Same seed and recipe on both sides; only `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM` changes.

- 600-second screens with simulated recipe acceptance; c1 uses block 7 / window 8 and AITER-managed KV splits.
- The AMD MonoKernel is off on both sides (its warmup aborted at startup).
- Screens use `--unsafe-override`; the request mix varies with completion rate, so P90 ITL is the primary signal.

| Recipe | Metric | Gluon | FP8-Q ASM | Delta |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| c1 | P90 ITL | 6.77 ms | 6.18 ms | **-8.7%** |
| c1 | P90 TTFT | 1019 ms | 959 ms | -5.9% |
| c1 | Total tok/s/GPU | 2996 | 2955 | -1.4% |
| c1 | Completed requests | 53 | 54 | +1.9% |

With the AMD MonoKernel on: a later pair of 600-second c1 screens, same recipe, AITER planning the MLA KV splits, block 7, simulated acceptance length 3.84, measured 2026-11-01. Only the MLA backend changes. Not submission-valid hours.

| Recipe | Metric | Gluon | FP8-Q ASM | Delta |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| c1 | P90 ITL | 5.18 ms | 4.50 ms | **-13.1%** |
| c1 | P90 interactivity | 193.05 | 222.22 | **+15.1%** |
| c1 | P90 TTFT | 956 ms | 931 ms | -2.6% |
| c1 | Total tok/s/GPU | 3130 | 3183 | +1.7% |
| c1 | Completed requests | 59 | 64 | +8.5% |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch: @@ -1942,6 +1942,16 @@ SGLang supports various environment variables that can be used to configure its Token count above which SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSE_KDA_INPROJ stops applying and the split projection runs instead. The merged shape is only faster while the projection is bandwidth bound. 256 + + SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM + gfx950, 12-head FP8 MLA with both SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DECODE_BACKEND and SGLANG_AITER_MLA_VERIFY_BACKEND on asm and no DCP: cast the query to FP8 and run decode and a verify window of up to SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_MAX_QLEN tokens on the persistent FP8-query ASM kernel. Under SGLANG_AITER_MLA_PERSIST=0 this turns persistence on for that decode and verify only, with the SGLANG_AITER_MLA_PERSIST=1 schedule; draft extend and other attention backends keep PERSIST=0. KV splits follow SGLANG_AITER_MLA_AUTO_KV_SPLITS. A wider window keeps the previous routing. A 2-4 token verify window also keeps the previous routing: on current AITER those FP8-query kernels return wrong output (ROCm/aiter#7007). Decode and 5-8 token windows are correct. + false + + + SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_MAX_QLEN + Widest verify window, in tokens (1 to 8), that SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM takes. AITER folds a 5-8 token window onto its 32-head qlen-4 kernel, which on MI355X beats Gluon only from about 128K tokens of context. + 4 + SGLANG_ROCM_GDN_ONLINE_MXFP4 On gfx95x with SGLANG_USE_AITER=1, quantize the BF16 GDN in_proj_qkvz and out_proj of Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.8 to MXFP4 after load. Projections with N or K not a multiple of 256 stay BF16. Batches of up to 64 rows run the AITER preshuffled MXFP4 GEMM if AITER has a tuned config for the shape. All other batches run the ASM gemm_a4w4. Set to 0 to keep the BF16 projections.

@@ -1154,6 +1154,12 @@ class Envs:
     SGLANG_AITER_MLA_VERIFY_BACKEND = EnvStr("asm")
     # Let aiter plan the KV splits for the asm persistent MLA decode.
     SGLANG_AITER_MLA_AUTO_KV_SPLITS = EnvBool(False)
+    # gfx950 h12 fp8 MLA: decode and short verify on the persistent fp8-Q asm kernel,
+    # this backend only; 2-4 token windows stay off until ROCm/aiter#7007 is fixed.
+    SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM = EnvBool(False)
+    # Widest verify window (1-8) that SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM takes; on MI355X,
+    # aiter's folded 5-8 token kernel beats Gluon only from about 128K context.
+    SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_MAX_QLEN = EnvInt(4)
     # Run gfx942 block-FP8 linears with the AITER CK blockscale GEMM instead of Triton.
     SGLANG_AITER_GFX942_BLOCKSCALE_USE_CK = EnvBool(True)

@@ -116,6 +116,46 @@
 
 # Max qlen limitation of the asm ps kernels to handle q with bf16 dtype
 _MLA_ASM_PS_MAX_QLEN = 4
+# 16 padded heads times the window must fit aiter's 128-row fold.
+_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_FOLD_MAX_QLEN = 8
+# The fp8-Q kernels return wrong output for these verify windows (ROCm/aiter#7007).
+_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_BROKEN_QLENS = frozenset(range(2, 4 + 1))
+
+
+def _fp8_q_asm_mla_selected(
+    *,
+    enabled: bool,
+    num_head: int,
+    head_pad_mode: str,
+    kv_cache_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    decode_backend: str,
+    verify_backend: str,
+    dcp_world_size: int,
+    verify_qlen: int,
+    gfx95: bool,
+    max_verify_qlen: int = _MLA_ASM_PS_MAX_QLEN,
+) -> bool:
+    # The native 16-head fp8-Q kernel covers up to _MLA_ASM_PS_MAX_QLEN tokens;
+    # a wider window folds onto the 32-head kernel, which wins only at long context.
+    if not enabled:
+        return False
+    if not 1 <= max_verify_qlen <= _MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_FOLD_MAX_QLEN:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"fp8-Q asm MLA max verify qlen must be in "
+            f"[1, {_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_FOLD_MAX_QLEN}], got {max_verify_qlen}"
+        )
+    return (
+        num_head == 12
+        and head_pad_mode == "zero"
+        and kv_cache_dtype == fp8_dtype
+        and decode_backend == "asm"
+        and verify_backend == "asm"
+        and dcp_world_size <= 1
+        and gfx95
+        and 1 <= verify_qlen <= max_verify_qlen
+        and verify_qlen not in _MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_BROKEN_QLENS
+    )
+
 
 # (query head count -> query lengths) at which aiter's scheduler treats the
 # count as native, on gfx950 with an fp8 query and KV. None means any length.
@@ -394,6 +434,7 @@ class AiterAttnBackend(AttentionBackend):
 
     # declare here to avoid CI failure in test_aiter_fp8_q_unified_attention.py
     use_mla_auto_kv_splits: bool = False
+    use_mla_fp8_q_asm: bool = False
 
     def __init__(
         self,
@@ -726,7 +767,25 @@ def __init__(
                     intra_batch_mode = False
                 log_mla_gluon_capability(logger)
 
-            use_any_mla_persist = _use_mla_ps_kernel or self.use_mla_dcp_asm
+            self.use_mla_fp8_q_asm = _fp8_q_asm_mla_selected(
+                enabled=envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM.get(),
+                num_head=self.num_head,
+                head_pad_mode=self.head_pad_mode,
+                kv_cache_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype,
+                decode_backend=self.mla_decode_backend,
+                verify_backend=self.mla_verify_backend,
+                dcp_world_size=self.dcp_world_size,
+                verify_qlen=self.num_draft_tokens or 1,
+                gfx95=is_gfx95_supported(),
+                max_verify_qlen=envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_MAX_QLEN.get(),
+            )
+            if self.use_mla_fp8_q_asm:
+                logger.info(
+                    "aiter MLA: decode/verify use the FP8-Q ASM kernel (qlen<=%s)",
+                    envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_MLA_FP8_Q_ASM_MAX_QLEN.get(),
+                )
+
+            use_any_mla_persist = self._mla_ps_kernel_enabled() or self.use_mla_dcp_asm
             self.max_split_per_batch = 32 if use_any_mla_persist else None
 
             if self.num_draft_tokens is None and use_any_mla_persist:
@@ -749,8 +808,11 @@ def __init__(
                     "aiter MLA: aiter plans the KV splits "
                     "(SGLANG_AITER_MLA_AUTO_KV_SPLITS=1)"
                 )
-                fast_mode = True
-                intra_batch_mode = False

+        self.assertEqual(scale.item(), 1.0)
+
+    def test_fp8_query_preserves_existing_scale(self):
+        _, q_in, scale, original_scale = self._run_decode(
+            enabled=True, qlen=8, query_dtype=fp8_dtype
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(q_in.dtype, fp8_dtype)
+        self.assertIs(scale, original_scale)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
